$comment: Which Apple Reminders lists hold tasks. THIS FILE IS ALEX'S — the agent
reads it and never writes it, like integrations/ignored-senders.json.
Anything in a list named here becomes an obligation on the To Do page.
Everything else is read, counted and left alone: `skipped()` reports it, so
'seen, not read' and 'there was nothing there' never look the same.
Alex, 2026-09-18, when the first extract turned 'Thank you for Smoking'
from his Shows & Movies list into a task due nothing: the default list only.
Add a list here to include it; the file being absent means the same thing.
The mirror the assistant writes lives in its own list (Obligations) and is never read
back from here, whatever this file says.
